comments.author: @loriolsen5785
comments.text: These videos actually bring me HOPE. People are finally waking up. The phase of despair and anger that we are seeing in these videos are grief over the loss of illusions that were sold to us for decades. Debt culture, consumer culture, the "buy now, pay later" culture...it is dying. And that's a good thing. Return to sensible financial management, budgeting, not buying anything until you can afford it in cash (not houses, obviously.) Invest in your retirement by living lean so you won't have to work until you die. Take care of yourselves, stop waiting for others to figure it out for you. I was there. We were in major debt, went from 2 incomes down to 1 when our twins were born, had to learn to budget, and made a LOT of changes in our family life. The world can feel upside-down when things change. But dig in, get smarter, pull harder on each dollar, and demand more from corporations who post billion-dollar profits while hourly employees live in their cars. Now, to pay employees more, they want to charge customers more for products and services. We have to say No to that, too. I'm all for companies making a profit, paying taxes to the government, and taking care of their employees. But there's a limit on that profit when it makes them billionaires and we cannot afford to eat.
